test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Name the first Indian female Bharatnatyam dancer to be awarded with the Padma Vibhushan.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sonal Mansingh.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sonal Mansingh**

 
 
• ​Sonal Mansingh is an Indian **classical dancer **and **Guru Bharatanatyam** and **Odissi dancing style**
 
• She has been nominated by the President of India to become a Member of Parliament, Rajya Sabha. 
 
• She is the youngest recipient of** Padma Bhushan in 1992** and Padma Vibhushan in 2003.
 
• She is the first Indian female Bharatnatyam dancer to be awarded with the Padma Vibhushan.
 
• **In 2018**, she was honored with **Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship.**
 
• She is also known as Akademi Ratna, for her contribution in the field of performing arts.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hema Malini**

 
 
• **​**Hema Malini is an Indian actress, director, producer, and politician.
 
• She is primarily known for her work in Hindi films. 
 
• She is a trained** Bharatanatyam dancer.**
 
• During her career, she received eleven nominations for the Filmfare Award for Best Actress.
 
• She is among the most successful leading actresses of mainstream Hindi cinema.
 
 
 
• **Yamini Krishnamurthy**
 
 
• **​**Mungara Yamini Krishnamurthy is an **Indian dancer of Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi styles** of dancing.
 
• She has the honor of being Asthana Nartaki of the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam.
 
• She was also known as "**torch bearer" **of the Kuchipudi form of dance.
 
• She imparts dance lessons to younger dancers at her institute, Yamini School of Dance, Hauz Khas, New Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Vyjayanthimala Bali**
 
 
• **​**Vyjayanthimala is a former Indian actress, dancer and parliamentarian.
 
• She is regarded as the** "First Female Superstar" **of Hindi cinema.
 
• She is the recipient of several accolades, including two BFJA Awards and five Filmfare Awards. 
 
 

187:T1
